description: This file defines an extension controller class 'Fixer' for the OpenCart admin API, responsible for managing currency conversion via the Fixer.io API. It includes methods for displaying the currency configuration page and saving currency settings, including fetching exchange rates from Fixer.io.

classes.name: Fixer
classes.description: Controller class for managing currency exchange rate updates via Fixer.io API within the OpenCart admin panel.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Loads the language file, sets the page title, builds breadcrumb navigation, loads currency data, and renders the currency configuration view.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving the Fixer API settings and updating currency exchange rates based on API response, with permission checks and JSON response.

methods.name: currency
methods.description: Fetches current exchange rates from Fixer.io API if enabled, updates database currencies accordingly.
